steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: This isn't it...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If things were really so simple, then I would find myself worried about Mr. Liang's eye for talent.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Mr. Zheng, do we know anything about the visitor from Lungmen yet?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: He's an old friend of Liang Xun's.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Anything special about him?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: We have a few unclear leads, but I can at least guarantee that this affair has nothing to do with Lord Wei.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: That's my father's greatest worry taken care of.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: True though, considering the sort of methods that Lord Wei of Lungmen usually employs... If he were involved, we wouldn't be sitting here enjoying tea right now.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I've heard many anecdotes about him over the years. It's a shame that I've never had the chance to visit Lungmen to see his exploits with my own eyes.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm surprised that you'd show such a keen interest in someone like him.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I walked the world of kung fu in my younger years, and I've heard he's fine swordsman. That's all.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I see. It's true that he's a swordsman... As for his swordsmanship, though, all I know is rumors.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In any case, can we assume it was Mr. Liang himself who chose to involve the Lungmenite?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Undoubtedly.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hm... He is the only remaining variable, and also Mr. Liang's only trump card.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Mr. Liang should've been on our side. The man he chose should not have tried to deceive me either. It was an illogical move.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Mr. Liang doesn't have much of a choice himself. If only... *Sigh*... No, it wouldn't have mattered.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Isn't her presence in Shangshu the reason everything has gotten so out of hand?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: The Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks... A place graced by the presence of a deity.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: In eras past, Shangshu was a place where many dreamed. Not only people but all inanimate things. As the saying goes, all things in the world can be deified with souls, and all words in the realm can be summarized in a sigh.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: According to legend, a millennium ago the Yanese towns were scattered all over the country. It was only when our Shangshu forebears all collectively saw the same dream that they chose to settle down on these lands.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The legends of Shangshu have always been so magnificent.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Outsiders may see it as mere legend, but to the locals it is history.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Operator from the medical company... Kroos, was it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If it wasn't for your help, she would likely have caught up to me. You have my thanks, Mr. Zheng.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You once saved my daughter from having her hotheadedness lead to disaster. It is only natural for me to come to your aid.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: At the end of the day, Rhodes Island is an unknown. What do you think, Innkeeper?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: They are not a part of the game.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: They are nonetheless standing very close to the table.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Hmm... I rarely see young a woman with such fine techniques, though. Seeing her chase after you gave me a good idea of her abilities.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And what's your assessment?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: She may be young, but she's a battle-hardened veteran.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hoh? Did you arrive at that conclusion as Zheng the Innkeeper or Zheng Qingyue, the Asker to the Frost?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Both.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You haven't once looked away from that fake cup.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I'm only reminiscing... reminiscing about the goblet's original form.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: When we crossed that wilderness all those years ago... we ran into a group of bandits. None of them spoke Yanese, and we hadn't the slightest idea where they came from.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: They blew up the caravan and tried to steal our wares, though our Escort Association colleagues stopped them. Still, there were far too many, all obsessed with our wares, and they followed us for two hundred li.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It was raining. Visibility was low, and there was nary a light in sight. The bandits, who knew the terrain much better, followed us like shadows.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: We were afraid to counterattack, lest they have some kind of underhanded trick up their sleeves. We were too afraid to run either, lest we couldn't shake them.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: From what I heard, the Sui Regulator once secretly commissioned the renowned Xingyu Escort Association to transport an item, only for it to be lost in an accident en route.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: That was my fault.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm afraid I'm not very good with comforting words, Mr. Zheng.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I simply never expected that the next time I met a crossbowman of such horrifying prowess would be in my hometown, in the dead center of the city, under a well-lit night, all for the same goblet.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I truly... cannot begin to explain how I feel.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How did you escape then, Mr Zheng?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: When do you mean?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Oh... The incident you were just talking about, of course. My father always tells me that I am still young and inexperienced, and should learn from my elders.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If you would continue to share your story with me, I'll gladly listen.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Luck was on my side that night...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Two of my men were hurt. Good men. Neither of them made it.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: The Association's rule is to 'save the goods, then the men.' We all knew the risks when we joined the business.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: But with the injured dead and the goods threatened, that actually freed us to do as we pleased.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It was pouring that night. Helped to wash the blood off our blades.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So you just need me to find the cup's owner?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: By owner, you mean a buyer or collector?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Not quite. It would be a much simpler matter if that were the case.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hm, that's strange. This cup was shockingly cheap, but according to the black market appraisal I stole from the smugglers, it seems...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's an actual antique, through and through.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Who's the man of the hour then?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I don't know their name... Nor anything else, really. Their gender, their race, their age...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well... Where am I supposed to start then...? Are you even sure they're in Shangshu?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: That much is certain, and only that.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How do you know? Suppose our friend decides to take a trip, wouldn't that make this a huge waste of time?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: No, they are in Shangshu. I can guarantee you that.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: If they had left Shangshu... I would have been notified.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Strange. So you can monitor them, but you can't locate them?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: That's right...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Are they some kind of monster or enlightened deity?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You'll know what I mean once you see them.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So they must leave some kind of indication that they're here... Is this the kind of funny business government officials have to deal with these days?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Fine, I won't probe any further if you don't want to tell me. It's just, that's not much of a lead in a town this big...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: They're most likely hiding in one of the Three Mounts.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How do you figure?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Our friend is unpredictable, but every once in a while they show up at the mountainside liquor shops to buy alcohol, with no regularity whatsoever.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: But they've never come down to the valleys, nor have they ever appeared in the nomadic cities. In which case, they're most likely somewhere in the mountains.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Very well, then. The Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks it is. Sounds like a fun trip.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Legend has it that our friend is an appreciator of fine weather and scenery. And they enjoy lounging in pavilions and writing poetry all the more.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Legend, huh?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It is more than mere legend, actually...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So you're familiar with them?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Not exactly.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: In the end, you may just have to try your luck, troublesome as it sounds.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Do we have a deadline?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I'd appreciate it if you'd take care of this as soon as possible. As you can tell, a few too many people are already mixed up in this affair. The longer it continues, the greater the chance it will get even more out of hand.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: As for the cup... Seeing as someone has their eyes on it, we should keep it in the safety of my estate.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Amazing, Mr. Liang. First you had me bring it to you across thousands of li, then you want me to find its owner, and now you won't even let me hold it?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're really putting me in quite a bind. Perhaps next time you'll arrange for me to help you from the comfort of Lungmen?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: This is a sign of my trust in you.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's true though that if someone has their eyes on it, then keeping it on my person is asking for trouble.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: As for the Xingyu Inn...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: We're investigating it. Be careful on your way. If you need help, I can arrange for someone to accompany you.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: No need. A bodyguard tagging along would just make me stand out. It's trouble, and you know it.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Are you certain you'll be fine on your own, though...?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Sure, as long as you aren't hiding anything else from me.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm looking for someone, not investigating a scary smuggler ring in Lungmen. How much trouble can it be?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: At least talk to Master Shen. As a veteran boatman, he can help you get anywhere in Shangshu.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Incidentally...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Is there a Zuanjiang Peak among Shangshu's Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Urgh! Just how stubborn are you, bitch?!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Well, you're the only lead I've got. Not letting you go.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You're all alone, with no lackeys. And are you sure you want to start a fight in a bustling part of town like this?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: How much did that thief from Lungmen pay you to cover him like this?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I don't know how things got to this point, but Mr. Lee is one of our most important partners.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Partners? Business then. And you believe him, just like that? You sure he's not swindling you?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I trust Rhodes Island, so I trust him. Simple as that.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Oh...? Seems we won't be coming to an agreement, then.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Looks like.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But Innkeeper Zheng also said not to get you any more mixed up in this than you already are.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh... Judging by your reaction, Mr. Lee got it right, then? You're in this with the innkeeper?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: You... Playing me for a fool, are you?! You're just some shady girl from who-knows-where! How dare you make a fool of me!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Fine, I'll make sure you pay for this!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: So we're doing this for real, huh?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Alright, I've actually got a few things to ask you—Nothing to do with Mr. Lee, but still.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Regarding Miss Du...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: She may be my daughter, but I'm ashamed to say she is still very immature.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No, she's your family. I am in no position to meddle in your household affairs.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How many inns and restaurants have you opened here in your town?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Hohoh... I've spent my entire my life savings on this business. Fortunately, my old pals take care of me these days. The connections I made over the years finally came in handy.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: *Sigh*... While it takes connections to survive in this business, of course, in the end it's all down to how capable you are. Being a businessman is another thing entirely. It takes skills to start a business, but connections to build it up.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: No doubt you are already well aware of that though.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Not at all. My father always tells me what youngsters like me lack isn't persistence or conviction. It's an understanding of everything that surrounds us.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Wise words. Indeed, being holed up in a castle in the clouds is no way to live.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Still, General Zuo is a good father, but it doesn't matter what your father thinks. What is truly important is... what you think.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Don't worry about that too much. When you are young, there is no shame in letting your frustration, curiosity, or anger get the better of you.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: On the contrary, young man, you don't want to lose your edge too early.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Thank you for your advice.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: *Sigh*... My advice wasn't just for you. It may sound simple, but it is no simple matter. I had to hear it for myself, all the same.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: My daughter... What a headache she is.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: ––Hraaaagh!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hm. Nice moves.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Spare me the act... It didn't even connect.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: How come you're like a whole different person when you're fighting...? My mate Mr. Nothing is like that too. Are all you Yanese like that?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I don't want to hurt anyone, that's all.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You called us thieves, didn't you? Aren't you going a little too easy on a thief?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Save it.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's not going to fly this time.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Heh... How about we stop beating around the bush, then?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Sure thing, I'm all for it. Gotta warn you, though. I'm not exactly speaking for Mr. Lee here.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Doesn't matter. Neither you nor that conman are the honest sort. The sooner we get this conversation over with, the better.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Who did you say you were again?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Codename Kroos, an Operator currently on deployment from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: So Mr. Nothing is that guy's codename?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Something like that. He's not quite on the job just yet, though.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: You work behind fake names, hiding knives beneath your smiles. What a sketchy lot.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Whoa... Never heard that one before...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Someone hired us to take the cup back from the Lungmenite.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Yanese is a tricky language, and I can't say I've had time to master it, but wouldn't you say using the phrase 'take back' here is a little too convenient?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I trust Mr. Lee. If you really had a grievance, or if this were all a misunderstanding, did it really have to come to blows?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: This is the Yanese heartland, not Siracusa or Bolívar... violence won't get you anywhere.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I have my reasons to open with hostilities instead of courtesies... That said, do you seriously not know anything?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh, so now I'm the one who's getting played for a fool, huh?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: If you really don't know, you'd best stay out of this and dig no further. I've already spoken with the Lungmenite. If you insist on sticking your nose into this, you'll ruin it for everyone.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Well, aren't a righteous one?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What we are doing is righteous. Naturally, our reasons are righteous too.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Now that I've told you this much, I might as make this clear, whether you believe me or not:

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —I didn't rob the Liang estate.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But you know who did.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Perhaps.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You say you've already talked to Mr. Lee... so how about a truce? Can you give us an explanation we'd accept?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: An explanation...?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: You said the Lungmenite was hired by Magistrate Liang to deliver a goblet from Lungmen—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —So the one who hired the Escort Association could be someone even Liang Xun is afraid to offend.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: It's beyond complicated. Don't count on me to explain it to you.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Miss Du!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor! Are you alright?!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: You punk! You here to get in our way too?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I haven't even said anything yet!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Get him, boys!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hmph... That's enough chit-chat for one night. Excuse me.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Get out of here. Stop badgering that guy already!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: —Alright!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hey, first you say you'll come get me, and now you don't?! Must you always give me such trouble?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —Hold on!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: You ain't half bad, and you know how to listen. So I'll leave you with a piece of advice—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —The mountain rapids are turbulent and steep! Stay out of this!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm fine... Don't worry.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Miss Du, are you okay?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Aren't those two working with the Lungmenite? Why don't we just tell them the truth?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I know what I'm doing.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Old Man Zheng wants to dump this on us... Well, that's not going to happen.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I've got a deal with the Lungmenite. The old banner has flown long enough. It's time to switch it out for a new one.
